children: The Reserve Bank of Australia is now consistently indicating its discomfort about excessive demand in the economy, adding in its public commentary that the situation has to be tackled, says Ivan Colhoun, an economist at Marex. It has also stressed that it must get inflation out of the system and that there are signs inflation is becoming dangerously embedded, Colhoun adds. The RBA's messaging now highlights that the pain of higher inflation is something impacting the entire population, rather than just home buyers, he adds. Colhoun expects an interest rate rise in November.(james.glynn@wsj.com; @JamesGlynnWSJ)
